assets.title: 야시장 마감 장부
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: concept art showing a playable 2D indie strategy game screenshot for a Korean game-design blog.
Primary request: ONE landscape 16:9 gameplay screen for an original cozy night-market food-stall resource puzzle, "NIGHT MARKET". Clearly communicate taking a whole mixed ingredient crate, limited fridge space, mushroom orders, cooking and equipment choices. This is an imagined game UI, not a poster.
Scene/backdrop: Warm evening Korean-inspired street food stall, amber paper lamps and a subdued teal city night beyond the countertop. No real branding.
Composition/framing: Straight-on readable game interface, slight hand-drawn tabletop perspective. Large central wooden worktop holds exactly FOUR open ingredient crates in a neat row. Highlight the second crate with a fine gold outline and small pointer: three large recognizable mushrooms and two red peppers, visually countable. Other crates contain eggs, mushrooms or peppers. On the left, a compact FRIDGE panel has eight clear storage slots, six occupied and two empty, labeled "6/8". On the right, a large order card shows a appetizing mushroom pancake icon, three mushroom icons and reward "12". Smaller next-order card beneath. Along the bottom are two large clear buttons "COOK" and "UPGRADE", plus equipment cards illustrated as a drying rack and a broth pot. Include top bar "TURN 7/12" and coin count "36".
Style/medium: Polished original 2D indie board-game-like illustration, soft painted shapes, crisp restrained outlines, tactile wood and ceramic, expressive ingredient icons, calm uncluttered hierarchy. Clean readable UI at blog width. No borrowed art, no existing board-game card layouts.
Lighting/mood: Welcoming warm light, small strategic dilemma visible through the highlighted oversized crate and almost-full fridge.
Text (verbatim only): "NIGHT MARKET", "TURN 7/12", "36", "FRIDGE", "6/8", "12", "COOK", "UPGRADE". All text short accurate English or numbers. Do not render any other lettering.
Constraints: One coherent gameplay view filling the whole image, four crates, clearly readable limited fridge, mushroom order, two action buttons. No people needed, no text captions, no collage, no multi-panel layout, no title-poster composition, no watermark, no Korean glyphs.
assets.review: view_image 확인: 재료상자 4개, 버섯3+고추2 선택상자, 냉장고8슬롯 중6개 점유, 버섯전 주문, COOK/UPGRADE 버튼, 설비2종 모두 확인.

assets.title: 옥상 정원의 사계절
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: concept art showing a playable 2D indie strategy game screenshot for a Korean game-design blog.
Primary request: ONE landscape 16:9 gameplay screen for an original seasonal rooftop-garden placement puzzle, "ROOFTOP GARDEN". Visually explain a 5 by 5 garden board, connected blue water channels, tree shade affecting plants, visible forecast, and selecting a paired tile plus seed. This is an imagined game UI, not a poster.
Scene/backdrop: Quiet urban rooftop overlooking a softly painted distant neighborhood, morning sky and small rooftop railing.
Composition/framing: The central 70 percent is a clearly countable exactly 5 by 5 square tile garden, seen from a high three-quarter almost-top-down angle with all 25 cells visible. Pale stone borders preserve grid readability. A blue water channel runs through adjacent tiles from a small cistern; young sunflowers, leafy ferns, and several empty soil cells. Exactly two leafy trees cast translucent cool blue shade overlays onto neighboring squares, the shade clearly belongs to the gameplay grid and does not obscure the plants. Show one ghost-preview tree tile above an empty cell with a fine pale outline.
Right panel: season card "NEXT" then "SUMMER" with sunshine icon and rain icon "1"; beneath, plant scoring cards with sunflower icon "+3", fern icon "+2".
Bottom tray: THREE well-separated selectable bundle cards; each card visibly contains one landscape tile icon and one seed packet icon connected by a small plus symbol. The center bundle is selected by a gold outline. Bottom right button "PLANT".
Top bar: "ROOFTOP GARDEN", "TURN 6/16", leaf score "18". Beside the grid include an unobtrusive sun-direction arrow icon.
Style/medium: Beautiful calm original 2D indie strategy game, hand-painted botanical shapes with crisp restrained outlines, readable board-game-style tiles, pastel sage, terracotta, warm cream, muted sky blue. Cohesive illustration and UI, not photorealistic and not 3D glossy.
Text (verbatim only): "ROOFTOP GARDEN", "TURN 6/16", "18", "NEXT", "SUMMER", "1", "+3", "+2", "PLANT". All lettering short accurate English or numbers; no other prose.
Constraints: One coherent gameplay screen filling the whole image; garden tiles are the focal point; strictly 5 by 5 grid; visible water-and-shade mechanics; exactly three paired choices. No people needed, no collage, no poster, no watermark, no Korean glyphs.
edit_prompts:
Edit this existing ROOFTOP GARDEN gameplay concept image. Change ONLY the garden board topology and the bundle selection coherence. Preserve the exact 16:9 framing, hand-painted art, rooftop background, all UI panels, all English text, score, water and tree aesthetic, lighting and palette.
The central board must be an unmistakable EXACT 5 COLUMN by 5 ROW square grid, exactly 25 equally sized garden cells. The previous image incorrectly had too many columns. Make the cells broader so exactly five columns fit in the same board width. Each cell must be bordered; water channels should occupy full cells in this 25-cell grid and should not create extra thin lanes between columns. Keep a connected blue water channel, two trees with clearly visible blue shade overlays, ferns, sunflowers, empty soil, and the ghost preview tree. Move the gold selection outline in the bottom choice tray from the middle card to the RIGHT card showing a path tile plus tree seed, so it corresponds to the ghost tree.
No other changes. Before drawing make the board count exactly five tiles across and five down. No added text.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Edit the provided ROOFTOP GARDEN gameplay concept image. Preserve absolutely everything including its EXACT 5 by 5 garden grid, all English text, panels, forecast, shade overlays, two trees, flowers, bundle cards, framing and palette. Change ONLY THREE empty soil cells to blue water-channel cells to connect the existing disconnected water pools. Number rows 1 to 5 from back/top to front/bottom, columns 1 to 5 from left to right. Convert row 2 column 2, row 2 column 3, and row 4 column 3 from soil to blue water, matching the existing water tiles. Open tiny connections in neighboring tile borders so the water forms one physically continuous path: r1c1 → r2c1 → r2c2 → r2c3 → r3c3 → r4c3 → r4c4 → r5c4. Keep each cell boundary readable and keep the exact 25-cell grid. No other changes, no extra tiles, no added text.
assets.review: view_image 확인: 최종 이미지 정확한5x5격자, 연결 수로, 나무그늘, 여름강수1 예보, 묶음선택3개, 나무 배치 미리보기. 최초 격자 초안과 물길 단절 문제를 이미지 편집으로 수정.

assets.title: 달빛 우편국
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: concept art showing a playable 2D indie strategy game screenshot for a Korean game-design blog.
Primary request: ONE landscape 16:9 gameplay screen for an original moonlit postal boat route scheduling game, "MOONLIGHT POST". Show seven islands, connected sea routes, two mail boats, departure reservations and urgent delivery deadlines. This is a readable playable tactical game interface, not a poster.
Scene/backdrop: A cozy archipelago at twilight with a deep indigo sea and quiet moon reflections. Islands contain tiny illustrated post offices, warm harbor lamps, cottages and docks, but no people.
Composition/framing: High almost-top-down route-map view dominates left 75 percent of screen. Exactly SEVEN separate islands, all with circular number badges 1 through 7, arranged in an organic open network. Ten thin dotted route lines connect pairs of island harbors. Avoid all route crossings by sensible geographic placement. Highlight one route in warm amber with small clock badge "02:00", other routes faint cyan. Exactly TWO stylized postal boats visible: one amber boat with a small envelope icon near island 2, one teal boat with an envelope icon near island 5. Route selection uses a subtle halo and arrow toward destination island 4.
On the right, clean paper-and-brass contract sidebar: top order card shows envelope icon "2 → 4", clear red deadline badge "BY 02:00", coin reward "12". A second card shows parcel icon "5 → 7", "BY 04:00", reward "8".
Along the bottom, a compact route reservation schedule for selected route "2 → 4" with four rectangular time slots labeled "01:00", "02:00", "03:00", "04:00"; 01:00 muted unavailable, 02:00 selected amber with one tiny boat marker, 03:00 and 04:00 empty. Bottom right clear button "RESERVE". Top bar "MOONLIGHT POST", "01:00", coins "24".
Style/medium: Original polished 2D indie logistics game illustration, hand-painted ocean and terrain with restrained crisp outlines, charming tiny boats, compact readable UI. Midnight blue, pale turquoise, warm paper, small amber accents. The route and reservation decision must be instantly readable.
Text (verbatim only): "MOONLIGHT POST", "01:00", "02:00", "03:00", "04:00", "24", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "2 → 4", "5 → 7", "BY 02:00", "BY 04:00", "12", "8", "RESERVE". Only short accurate English or numbers, no other lettering.
Constraints: One coherent gameplay view filling whole frame, exactly seven numbered islands and two boats, visible timetable and urgent deadline, no collage, no poster, no watermark, no Korean glyphs.
assets.review: view_image 확인: 번호1~7 운항섬, 점선항로, 우편선2척, 2→4 강조항로, 시간예약4슬롯, 납기표시2종 확인. 배경 장식섬은 운항노드가 아님.
